action.objective: Consolidate queenside pressure and keep king safe, choosing between the two verified moves Qa8 and f5.
action.rationale: Only commit_ready moves are Qa8 and f5. Strongest exact evidence: Qa8 depth3 -113 (b7a7 hits the queen) vs f5 depth2 -34 but with f5 dropping a pawn to Rxf5/Nxf5/Bxf5. Shared depth-2 shows Qa8 +91 (b7b8) clearly above f5 -34. Qa8 offers exact depth-3 evidence and keeps the queen active attacking b8/a7; f5 is a pawn sac. Move Qa8, noting depth-3 line b7a7 forces queen retreat; depth-limited uncertainty acknowledged.
